text:
anya-cs: Heads up — Tempest (Telco) dedicated pool bring-up scheduled Thu 09:00 PT. Need a quick go/no-go checklist and owners. Main asks: quota gating, autoscale thresholds, load test window, KMS onboarding, and warm-priming for LLM responses. Can ops + SRE confirm who owns each? :eyes:
leo-ops: I can own autoscale thresholds + load test orchestration. Planning a 2-hour soak + spike test. Will propose thresholds: target 95p latency < 120ms, scale up at 60% GPU util, scale down below 30% for 10m. Sharing draft schedule in a sec. :thumbsup:
mohit-sre: +1 on ownership. For canary routing we should run 10% traffic to dedicated pool, fallback to hosted model if errors > 3% over 5m. Also need healthcheck endpoints for KV cache warm readiness. I'll add probes to the runbook.
sana-aml: For priming, we'll prepare a 200-prompt regression deck (intent coverage + prompt edgecases). Can run quality sweep pre and post warmup to detect generation drift. I'll upload the prompt set to the shared folder.
leo-ops: Draft schedule: 
```
Thu 08:00 PT - Preflight: KMS keys validated, ACLs checked
Thu 08:30 PT - Capacity warm: run prefix cache pump (5m ramp)
Thu 09:00 PT - Canary routing (10%) + soak 30m
Thu 09:30 PT - Spike window: synthetic burst test (10x for 5m)
Thu 10:00 PT - Full traffic cutover if metrics green
```
I'll run `wrk` style load script and attach the script after testing.
anya-cs: Thanks — Mohit can you confirm the fallback window and what metric triggers rollback? Also Ops please add billing alert for quota burn rate > expected (notify CS).
mohit-sre: Rollback triggers: error rate > 3% sustained for 5m OR token latency p95 > 250ms for 3m. Fallback policy: immediate traffic shift back to hosted tier, and create incident channel. I'll wire the automation in `routing-service` with these thresholds.
leo-ops: Added billing alert to the schedule and created a temp channel `#tempest-burst` for on-call. I'll post the `wrk` command there: `wrk -t12 -c400 -d300s --latency http://dedicated-tempest/endpoint`
sana-aml: Uploaded prompt_deck_v1.csv to the shared drive and tagged folks. We'll kick off a small quality sweep during the canary window. If we see hallucination uptick or style drift, we'll hold cutover.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: `reserved-pool/tempest` crate image v2.1 -> 2025-11-07T09:00:00Z. CI: green.
anya-cs: Perfect. Action items: Leo (autoscale + load scripts + channel), Mohit (canary routing + rollback automation), Sana (prompt deck + quality sweep), CS will monitor usage and notify Tempest PM during canary. Aim to meet + signoff by 10:15 PT. Anything else?
leo-ops: I'll also export a small synthetic traffic profile that mirrors Tempest's peak queries (includes short- and long-seq). Will share by EOD today.
mohit-sre: I'll add KV warm probe: `/health/kv_ready` and a simple `/metrics/token_latency` endpoint for the throttler to read.
sana-aml: If everyone is good, I'll schedule a 30m preflight call Wed 16:00 PT to walk the PM through the checklist.
anya-cs: Good call. Adding that. Thanks team :rocket:
